# Orvio 0.55

- See where a title comes from: film and series pages say "From:" with your providers, and Choose a version names the provider on each row when more than one offers it.
- Search by provider: with two or more playlists, Search has a row to pick one provider or All providers. A provider's search also finds titles another playlist has too.
- Playlist names are unique now: Orvio asks for another name when you already use one, and new playlists start with a free name.
